items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: I was going to ask about those records you made for Jelly Roll Morton... I know some of those fellas... Arnett Nelson used to tease Jelly Roll... But this guy, Arnett, myself, and Jelly Roll had two or three fellas there

ctx.x: Anyway, Brunus puffs out just one cheek. Just one cheek, yeah. Is he playing here? Yeah, he's up at the 11-11 Club at Bryn Mawr. Yeah? On the north side. He's been here for four years.

Another boy, too, was with them. I forget his name. He played trumpet. He quit playing, though. He's from downtown. What is that fellow's name? I couldn't think of a name. Jelliro knew them all. But Brunus is a raised trombone player, a puff boy. He's in jail like that.
Is there anything you can do about that?
